degrees.degree: PhD Candidate in Natural Language Processing
details: Research on efficient small language models for real-world NLP: few-shot classification, knowledge distillation, and retrieval-augmented generation.
Published at LREC-COLING 2024 (zero-shot classification with small LMs) and Interspeech 2025 (retrieval-enhanced few-shot SLU).
Benchmarked models across text classification, NER, and sentiment analysis; open-sourced fine-tuned models on Hugging Face.
